name: cable triceps pushdown (v bar)
description: A cable pushdown with a V bar that isolates the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Attach a V bar to a high pulley and stand facing the stack.
Grip the bar with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment at the bottom.
Let the bar rise until your forearms are just past parallel.
Keep your upper arms still throughout the set.
